description: This is a Java test source file for testing the interaction between timeout, response requirements, and acknowledgment requests in the HttpRequestActor component of the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses JUnit and Akka TestKit to verify different parameter combinations.

classes.name: HttpRequestActorHeaderInteractionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying header interactions with different parameters in HttpRequestActor, including timeout, response required flag, acknowledgment requests, and success state.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Provides parameter combinations for the parameterized test.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the test scenarios for different combinations of timeout, response required, requested acknowledgments, and success flag.

methods.name: setHeadersByParameter
methods.description: Creates and sets headers with the test parameters.

methods.name: getProbeResponse
methods.description: Generates the expected response object based on success or failure condition.

methods.name: getExpectedStatusCode
methods.description: Determines the expected HTTP status code based on timeout, response requirement, acknowledgments, and success.
